reply.text: {"route": "answer", "say": "I'll give you general context, not a dose. Most guidance for healthy adults tops out around 400mg of caffeine a day, and for racing that's usually 3-6mg per kg of bodyweight, taken an hour or so out. Pills make it easy to overshoot, and too much gets you jittery, nauseous, or needing a bathroom mid-race. Check with a doctor for what's right for you, and never test a new dose on race day itself - trial it in training first."}
